name: Hatsukoi Paraphilia
source:
"――I've killed a man, will you please shelter me?"

These words, uttered by a former junior colleague I hadn't seen in many years, were hard for me to believe.

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30732]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“——我杀了一个人，你可以庇护我吗？”

这句话出自一位多年未见的前低级同事之口，让我难以置信。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30732]Freem![/url]]
